summary: Stranded motorist at 12,500+ ft on Argentine Pass called Colorado 4x4 Rescue & Recovery for help on the evening of July 18; a team member picked him up within a couple of hours, and a team returned the next day to recover his vehicle (the caller said he would otherwise have spent the night freezing at altitude)
notes: CO4x4RnR mission report dated July 20, 2017 (parent search-corroborated); mining subagent opened the report live and confirmed the July-18 incident date from the caller thank-you note; central dedupe clean (run 909).
